Explanation of this code: 
1. Calculate incidence per 100,000 for each municipality-year
2. Sort municipality-years from lowest to highest incidence
3. Split them into 4 approximately equal-sized groups
4. Label them Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4
5. Summarize n, %, median, range, and missingness

For pesticide notification incidence, the code uses three core variables:ID_MN_RESI,ano_origem,populacao
population variables: cod_ibge,ano,populacao

Incidence calculation rate formula: 
incidence_100k = cases / population * 100000

3. Missingness function

```{r}
is_missing_value <- function(x) {
  is.na(x) | trimws(as.character(x)) == ""
}

# Missingness report
missingness_report <- function(data, vars) {
  data %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        all_of(vars),
        list(
          missing_n = ~sum(is_missing_value(.)),
          missing_percent = ~mean(is_missing_value(.)) * 100
        ),
        .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "variable_stat",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      stat = case_when(
        str_detect(variable_stat, "_missing_n$") ~ "missing_n",
        str_detect(variable_stat, "_missing_percent$") ~ "missing_percent",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      variable = variable_stat %>%
        str_remove("_missing_n$") %>%
        str_remove("_missing_percent$")
    ) %>%
    select(variable, stat, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = stat,
      values_from = value
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      missing_n = as.integer(missing_n),
      missing_percent = round(missing_percent, 2)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(missing_percent))
}

# Quartile or quantile summary function
quantile_summary <- function(data, variable, groups = 4, group_label = "Q") {
  
  variable <- rlang::ensym(variable)
  
  total_n <- nrow(data)
  
  missing_n <- data %>%
    summarise(missing_n = sum(is.na(!!variable))) %>%
    pull(missing_n)
  
  missing_percent <- missing_n / total_n * 100
  
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!variable)) %>%
    mutate(
      quantile_group_num = ntile(!!variable, groups),
      quantile_group = paste0(group_label, quantile_group_num)
    ) %>%
    group_by(quantile_group_num, quantile_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      median = median(!!variable, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(!!variable, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(!!variable, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
      range = paste0(round(min, 2), "–", round(max, 2)),
      missing_n = missing_n,
      missing_percent = missing_percent
    ) %>%
    select(
      quantile_group,
      n,
      percent,
      median,
      min,
      max,
      range,
      missing_n,
      missing_percent
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = round(percent, 2),
      median = round(median, 2),
      min = round(min, 2),
      max = round(max, 2),
      missing_percent = round(missing_percent, 2)
    )
}

```


4. Quartile summary by year
```{r}
quartile_summary_by_year <- function(data, variable, year_var, groups = 4, group_label = "Q") {
  
  variable <- rlang::ensym(variable)
  year_var <- rlang::ensym(year_var)
  
  data %>%
    group_by(!!year_var) %>%
    mutate(
      total_n_year = n(),
      missing_n = sum(is.na(!!variable)),
      missing_percent = missing_n / total_n_year * 100
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!variable)) %>%
    mutate(
      quantile_group_num = ntile(!!variable, groups),
      quantile_group = paste0(group_label, quantile_group_num)
    ) %>%
    group_by(!!year_var, quantile_group_num, quantile_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      median = median(!!variable, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(!!variable, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(!!variable, na.rm = TRUE),
      missing_n = first(missing_n),
      missing_percent = first(missing_percent),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(!!year_var) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
      range = paste0(round(min, 2), "–", round(max, 2))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      !!year_var,
      quantile_group,
      n,
      percent,
      median,
      min,
      max,
      range,
      missing_n,
      missing_percent
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      percent = round(percent, 2),
      median = round(median, 2),
      min = round(min, 2),
      max = round(max, 2),
      missing_percent = round(missing_percent, 2)
    )
}

# Safe rate function
rate_per_100k <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  if_else(
    !is.na(denominator) & denominator > 0,
    numerator / denominator * 100000,
    NA_real_
  )
}

```

5. Clean SINAN data 

```{r}
ibge_width <- 6

pesticide_clean <- pesticide_raw %>%
  mutate(
    ID_MN_RESI = str_pad(as.character(ID_MN_RESI), width = ibge_width, pad = "0"),
    SG_UF = as.character(SG_UF),
    ano_origem = as.integer(ano_origem),
    NU_ANO = as.integer(NU_ANO),
    
    ANO_NASC = suppressWarnings(as.integer(ANO_NASC)),
    
    CS_SEXO = as.character(CS_SEXO),
    CS_RACA = as.character(CS_RACA),
    AGENTE_TOX = as.character(AGENTE_TOX),
    LAVOURA = as.character(LAVOURA),
    CIRCUNSTAN = as.character(CIRCUNSTAN),
    EVOLUCAO = as.character(EVOLUCAO),
    SIT_TRAB = as.character(SIT_TRAB),
    HOSPITAL = as.character(HOSPITAL),
    
    idade = ano_origem - ANO_NASC,
    idade = if_else(idade < 0 | idade > 120, NA_integer_, idade),
    
    sex_label = case_when(
      CS_SEXO == "M" ~ "Male",
      CS_SEXO == "F" ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ "Missing/Unknown"
    ),
    
    occupational = CIRCUNSTAN == "02",
    agricultural = !is.na(LAVOURA) & trimws(LAVOURA) != "",
    
    death_intoxication = EVOLUCAO == "2",
    death_any_reported = EVOLUCAO %in% c("2", "3"),
    
    hospitalized = HOSPITAL == "1"
  )

```

8. Aggregate pesticide notifications by municipality-year

```{r}
pesticide_muni_year <- pesticide_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ID_MN_RESI),
    !is.na(ano_origem)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID_MN_RESI, ano_origem) %>%
  summarise(
    cases = n(),
    
    deaths_intoxication = sum(death_intoxication, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_any_reported = sum(death_any_reported, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    hospitalized_n = sum(hospitalized, na.rm = TRUE),
    occupational_n = sum(occupational, na.rm = TRUE),
    agricultural_n = sum(agricultural, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    male_n = sum(CS_SEXO == "M", na.rm = TRUE),
    female_n = sum(CS_SEXO == "F", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    median_age_cases = median(idade, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_age_cases = if_else(
      is.nan(median_age_cases),
      NA_real_,
      median_age_cases
    )
  )

```

11. Join population and pesticide data

```{r}
# This keeps all municipality-years from the population data.
# Municipality-years with no notifications become zero-case observations.

analysis_df <- population_muni_year %>%
  left_join(
    pesticide_muni_year,
    by = c("cod_ibge" = "ID_MN_RESI", "ano" = "ano_origem")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cases = replace_na(cases, 0L),
    deaths_intoxication = replace_na(deaths_intoxication, 0L),
    deaths_any_reported = replace_na(deaths_any_reported, 0L),
    hospitalized_n = replace_na(hospitalized_n, 0L),
    occupational_n = replace_na(occupational_n, 0L),
    agricultural_n = replace_na(agricultural_n, 0L),
    male_n = replace_na(male_n, 0L),
    female_n = replace_na(female_n, 0L),
    
    incidence_100k = rate_per_100k(cases, population),
    mortality_intoxication_100k = rate_per_100k(deaths_intoxication, population),
    mortality_any_reported_100k = rate_per_100k(deaths_any_reported, population),
    
    hospitalized_percent = if_else(cases > 0, hospitalized_n / cases * 100, NA_real_),
    occupational_percent = if_else(cases > 0, occupational_n / cases * 100, NA_real_),
    agricultural_percent = if_else(cases > 0, agricultural_n / cases * 100, NA_real_),
    male_percent = if_else(cases > 0, male_n / cases * 100, NA_real_),
    female_percent = if_else(cases > 0, female_n / cases * 100, NA_real_)

)

```

  summarise(
    total_population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_deaths_intoxication = sum(deaths_intoxication, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_deaths_any_reported = sum(deaths_any_reported, na.rm = TRUE),

    occupational_percent = total_occupational / total_cases * 100,

---------------------------------------
R Code for 0-14 Pesticide notifications 
---------------------------------------
1.Function for age analysis 
```{r}
rate_per_100k <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  if_else(
    !is.na(denominator) & denominator > 0,
    numerator / denominator * 100000,
    NA_real_
  )
}

age_group_0_14 <- function(age) {
  case_when(
    age >= 0  & age <= 3  ~ "0–3",
    age >= 4  & age <= 7  ~ "4–7",
    age >= 8  & age <= 10 ~ "8–10",
    age >= 11 & age <= 14 ~ "11–14",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Optional output folder
output_dir <- "outputs"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

```

2. Clean pesticide notification data for children 0–14
```{r}
pesticide_child <- pesticide_raw %>%
  mutate(
    ID_MN_RESI = str_pad(as.character(ID_MN_RESI), width = 6, pad = "0"),
    ano_origem = as.integer(ano_origem),
    ANO_NASC = suppressWarnings(as.integer(ANO_NASC)),
    
    CS_SEXO = as.character(CS_SEXO),
    EVOLUCAO = as.character(EVOLUCAO),
    HOSPITAL = as.character(HOSPITAL),
    CIRCUNSTAN = as.character(CIRCUNSTAN),
    LAVOURA = as.character(LAVOURA),
    
    # Approximate age using notification/reference year minus birth year
    idade = ano_origem - ANO_NASC,
    
    idade = if_else(idade < 0 | idade > 120, NA_integer_, idade),
    
    age_group = age_group_0_14(idade),
    
    sex_label = case_when(
      CS_SEXO == "M" ~ "Masculino",
      CS_SEXO == "F" ~ "Feminino",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    hospitalized = HOSPITAL == "1",
    occupational = CIRCUNSTAN == "02",
    agricultural = !is.na(LAVOURA) & trimws(LAVOURA) != "",
    
    death_intoxication = EVOLUCAO == "2",
    death_any_reported = EVOLUCAO %in% c("2", "3")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(idade),
    idade >= 0,
    idade <= 14,
    !is.na(age_group),
    !is.na(sex_label)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("0–3", "4–7", "8–10", "11–14")
    ),
    sex_label = factor(
      sex_label,
      levels = c("Masculino", "Feminino")
    )
  )


```

3. Clean population data for children 0–14

```{r}
population_child <- population_raw %>%
  mutate(
    cod_ibge = str_pad(as.character(cod_ibge), width = 6, pad = "0"),
    ano = as.integer(ano),
    idade = as.integer(idade),
    populacao = as.numeric(populacao),
    sexo = as.character(sexo),
    
    sex_label = case_when(
      sexo %in% c("Masculino", "M", "Male") ~ "Masculino",
      sexo %in% c("Feminino", "F", "Female") ~ "Feminino",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    age_group = age_group_0_14(idade)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(idade),
    idade >= 0,
    idade <= 14,
    !is.na(age_group),
    !is.na(sex_label)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("0–3", "4–7", "8–10", "11–14")
    ),
    sex_label = factor(
      sex_label,
      levels = c("Masculino", "Feminino")
    )
  )



```

6. Join cases and population

```{r}
analysis_child_age_sex <- population_child_muni_year_age_sex %>%
  left_join(
    pesticide_child_muni_year_age_sex,
    by = c(
      "cod_ibge" = "ID_MN_RESI",
      "ano" = "ano_origem",
      "age_group" = "age_group",
      "sex_label" = "sex_label"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cases = replace_na(cases, 0L),
    deaths_intoxication = replace_na(deaths_intoxication, 0L),
    deaths_any_reported = replace_na(deaths_any_reported, 0L),
    hospitalized_n = replace_na(hospitalized_n, 0L),
    occupational_n = replace_na(occupational_n, 0L),
    agricultural_n = replace_na(agricultural_n, 0L),
    
    incidence_100k = rate_per_100k(cases, population),
    mortality_intoxication_100k = rate_per_100k(deaths_intoxication, population),
    
    hospitalized_percent = if_else(cases > 0, hospitalized_n / cases * 100, NA_real_),
    occupational_percent = if_else(cases > 0, occupational_n / cases * 100, NA_real_),
    agricultural_percent = if_else(cases > 0, agricultural_n / cases * 100, NA_real_)
  )

```

9. Quartiles within age group and sex
This divides municipality-year observations into incidence quartiles separately within each age group and sex. eg: boys aged 0–3 get their own Q1–Q4, girls aged 0–3 get their own Q1–Q4, and so on.

```{r}
analysis_child_age_sex <- analysis_child_age_sex %>%
  group_by(age_group, sex_label) %>%
  mutate(
    incidence_quartile_num = if_else(
      !is.na(incidence_100k),
      ntile(incidence_100k, 4),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    incidence_quartile = paste0("Q", incidence_quartile_num),
    incidence_quartile = factor(
      incidence_quartile,
      levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

10. Quartiles Summary Table 

```{r}
quartile_child_age_sex <- analysis_child_age_sex %>%
  group_by(age_group, sex_label) %>%
  mutate(
    total_n = n(),
    missing_n = sum(is.na(incidence_100k)),
    missing_percent = missing_n / total_n * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(incidence_100k)) %>%
  group_by(age_group, sex_label, incidence_quartile) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
    median_incidence_100k = median(incidence_100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_incidence_100k = min(incidence_100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_incidence_100k = max(incidence_100k, na.rm = TRUE),
    range = paste0(
      round(min_incidence_100k, 2),
      "–",
      round(max_incidence_100k, 2)
    ),
    missing_n = first(missing_n),
    missing_percent = first(missing_percent),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = round(percent, 2),
    median_incidence_100k = round(median_incidence_100k, 2),
    min_incidence_100k = round(min_incidence_100k, 2),
    max_incidence_100k = round(max_incidence_100k, 2),
    missing_percent = round(missing_percent, 2)
  )
quartile_child_age_sex
```

11. Quartile counts by age group and sex

```{r}
p_quartile_counts_pct <- analysis_child_age_sex %>%
  filter(!is.na(incidence_quartile)) %>%
  count(age_group, sex_label, incidence_quartile, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(age_group, sex_label) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label = paste0(comma(n), "\n(", round(percent, 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = incidence_quartile,
      y = n,
      fill = incidence_quartile
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    vjust = -0.25,
    size = 3.1
  ) +
  facet_grid(sex_label ~ age_group) +
  labs(
    title = "Municipality-year counts by pesticide incidence quartile",
    subtitle = "Counts and percentages within each age group and sex",
    x = "Incidence quartile",
    y = "Number of municipality-years"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p_quartile_counts_pct

```
